title: Maps
art.replaceHint: A new image replaces the top layer’s and is stretched to the map’s frame.
art.formats: PNG, JPEG or WebP — you can also add it later.
manager.empty: No maps yet — create one to start placing markers on it.
manager.idleHint: Rest the pointer on a map to preview it, or click it to open.
manager.nestIntoSelf: A map can't go inside itself or one of its child maps.
hierarchy.nestBody: Dragging {map} inside {parent} will make it a child of it. Want to proceed?
hierarchy.nestBodyFromFolder: Dragging {map} inside {parent} will make it a child of it (and take it out of its folder). Want to proceed?
hierarchy.detachBody: Dragging {map} here will remove it as child of {parent}.
deleteFolder.title: Delete the folder “{name}”?
deleteFolder.body: The folder and every folder inside it will be deleted.
deleteFolder.mapsReturn_one: Its map will return to the root (no folder).
deleteFolder.mapsReturn_other: Its {n} maps will return to the root (no folder).
deleteFolder.noMapDeleted: No map is ever deleted with a folder.
deleteMap.title: Delete “{name}”?
deleteMap.body: The map moves to the Trash together with its layers, markers, zones, texts and lines.
deleteMap.keepChildren: Keep them, moved to the root
deleteMap.cascadeChildren: Move them (and their own children) to the Trash too
deleteMap.restoreHint: You can restore it from Settings → Trash.
newMapModal.uploadFailed: The map was created, but the artwork upload failed.
folderSettings.title: Folder settings
folderSettings.defaultColorHint: Back to the default folder color
mapSettings.title: Map settings
sidebar.dropHintMap: Drop on a folder to file it there, on a map to nest it, or here for the root.
sidebar.dropHintFolder: Drop on a folder to file it there or here for the root.
layerFolders.openHint: Click: open its settings, new {nouns} go here. Double-click to rename.
layerFolders.itemLockedHint: Locked: unlock to move or edit it
layerFolders.itemHint: Ctrl+click: pick several. Shift+click: pick a range. Drag to move or reorder.
layerFolders.summary: Folder on {layer} · {items}. New {nouns} go here while it's selected.
layerFolders.layersHint: Everything in the folder also shows (and can be edited) on these layers, on top of each {noun}'s own choice.
layerFolders.useStyle: New {nouns} in this folder use this style
layerFolders.styleOff: Off: new {nouns} get the tool's current style. Turning it on starts from that style.
layerFolders.holdsDelete: It holds {items}. They will be deleted with it.
layerFolders.holdsMove: It holds {items}. They move to Ungrouped.
layerFolders.multiHint: Changes apply to every selected {noun}. Settings marked {mixed} differ between them.
toolbar.activeLayerHint: Active layer — markers, zones, grid and image shown and edited
error.createRegionForZone: Could not create a region for the zone.
viewer.deleteLayerAll: “{name}” still has {parts}. Delete the layer and all of it?
zones.territory.label: Political territory (optional)
zones.territory.mixed: The selected zones link to different territories.
zones.region.name: Region name
zones.region.openHint: Click: open its settings, new zones go here. Double-click to rename.
zones.region.addHint: Start drawing a new zone in this Region
zones.tool.rectangleHint: Rectangle / Square — hold Shift for an equal-sided square
zones.tool.circleHint: Circle — press at the center and drag out the radius
zones.tool.polygonHint: Polygon — click each vertex, click the first point (or press Enter) to close; right-click or Backspace removes the last point
zones.tool.brushHint: Brush — paint a new zone, or paint onto the selected zone to grow it. [ and ] or Shift + mouse wheel change the size.
zones.tool.eraserHint: Eraser — erase part of the selected zone. [ and ] or Shift + mouse wheel change the size.
zones.brush.selectToErase: Select a zone to erase from.
zones.brush.needRegion: Create or select an unlocked, visible Region to paint.
zones.brush.deselectHint: Deselect so the next stroke starts a new zone (Esc)
zones.draw.needRegion: Create or select a Region to draw.
zones.area.calibrateOne: Calibrate the map’s scale (Scale & measure) to see this zone’s area.
zones.area.calibrateMany: Calibrate the map’s scale (Scale & measure) to see their area.
zones.multi.differentLayers: Their regions are on different layers.
zoneBar.label: Zone tools
zoneBar.selectHint: Select / edit — click a zone to change it
zoneBar.addZoneHint: Add zone — draw a new one ({shape})
zoneBar.brushSizeHint: Brush size — [ and ] or Shift + mouse wheel also change it
zoneBar.noRegions: This layer has no regions yet. Create one in the Zones panel.
zoneBar.moreHint: Name, area, territory, region and layers
textBar.label: Text tools
textBar.selectHint: Select / edit — click a text to change it, drag it to move it
textBar.placeHint: Place text — click the map where it goes
textBar.moreHint: Curve, spacing, outline, shadow, folder and layers
lineBar.label: Line tools
lineBar.selectHint: Select / edit — click a line to change it, drag it to move it
lineBar.freeHint: Free draw — hold the left button and drag (click again to stop)
lineBar.penHint: Pen — click for corners, click-and-drag for curves (click again to stop)
scaleBar.label: Scale tools
scaleBar.moveHint: Move the scale bar — drag it on the map, or focus it and use the arrow keys
scaleBar.calibrateHint: Calibrate — click two points a known distance apart and type that distance
scaleBar.unitsHint: Unit, step size, number of steps and the split first step
scaleBar.lookHint: Style, color, label size and background
areaBar.label: Area tools
areaBar.shapesHint: The shapes measured: pick one to read it alone, or remove it
travelBar.label: Travel tools
travelBar.selectHint: Select / edit — click a route to see its trip and change it
travelBar.drawHint: Draw route — click point by point on the map (click again to stop)
travelBar.tripHint: The trip: time, speed, distance a day and supplies
travelBar.howHint: Way of travel, pace, hours a day, terrain and travellers
travelBar.redrawHint: Redraw the route from scratch, keeping its settings
panel.folderBlocked: The folder is hidden or locked
panel.differentLayers: They're on different layers: move them to one layer first.
text.boldMixed: Bold (mixed: click to make them all bold)
text.mixedPlaceholder: They say different things. Typing here replaces the text of all of them.
text.editingHint: Editing the selected text. Drag it to move, the corners to scale, the round handle to rotate (Shift snaps), the side arrows to curve it.
text.idleHint: Click a text on the map or in the list to edit it, a folder for its settings. Ctrl/Shift+click picks several, Ctrl+A a whole folder.
text.ungroupedHint: Texts outside any folder. Click: new texts go here.
text.locked: Locked. Unlock it to move or edit it.
text.lockedByFolder: Locked by its folder. Unlock it to move or edit it.
text.folderStyle: New texts in “{name}” use the folder's default style.
lines.penHint: Click = corner, click-and-drag = curve, hold Shift for straight/45° segments. Right-click (or Enter) finishes, Backspace removes the last point, Esc cancels. Existing lines are ignored while drawing: stop drawing to edit one.
lines.freeHint: Hold the left button and drag to draw, over other lines too. Stop drawing to edit an existing line.
lines.idleHint: Click a line on the map or in the list to edit it, a folder for its settings. Ctrl/Shift+click picks several, Ctrl+A a whole folder.
lines.ungroupedHint: Lines outside any folder. Click: new lines go here.
lines.locked: Locked. Unlock it to move or edit it.
lines.lockedByFolder: Locked by its folder. Unlock it to move or edit it.
lines.smoothingHint: Steadies free-draw strokes: the pen trails the cursor a little, so hand shakes don't show. 0 = off.
lines.folderStyle: New lines in “{name}” use the folder's default style.
travel.creatureSpeedHint: Off: animals and wagons keep the walkers’ pace. On: speed ÷ 10 = mph at a normal pace.
travel.gallop: Gallop for an hour a day ({speed})
travel.roughHint: Share of the route through rough ground (forest, swamp, mountains): half speed there.
travel.noMove: This way of travel doesn’t move (check its speed).
travel.gallopNote: Includes a one-hour gallop each day ({distance}).
travel.calibrateHint: Travel times need real distances: set the map’s scale by measuring two points a known distance apart.
travel.idleHint: Click a route on the map or in the list to see and edit it, a folder for its settings. Ctrl/Shift+click picks several, Ctrl+A a whole folder.
travel.ungroupedHint: Routes outside any folder. Click: new routes go here.
travel.folderPlaceholder: Folder name (e.g. Trade roads, Campaign trips)
travel.locked: Locked. Unlock it to edit it.
travel.lockedByFolder: Locked by its folder. Unlock it to edit it.
travel.editHint: On the map: drag a point to move it, drag a + to add one, right-click (or double-click) a point to remove it.
travel.folderLook: New routes in “{name}” use the folder’s default look.
travel.mixedSettings: They’re travelled differently: shown is the first one’s. A change applies to all.
scale.calibrateHint: Tell the map how big it is: click two points a known distance apart (two cities, the ends of a road) and type that distance.
scale.calibrateFirst: Calibrate first; the bar needs to know the distances.
scale.unitHint: Changing the unit doesn’t convert the calibration: recalibrate if the distances change meaning.
scale.autoStepHint: When on, zooming far in or out picks a rounder step so the bar stays a readable size.
scale.measureHint: Click points on the map to measure a path in {unit}.
scale.measureHintPx: Click points on the map to measure a path (in map pixels until calibrated).
scale.barLabelEdit: Scale bar — drag or use the arrow keys to move it
scale.barDragHint: Drag to move the scale bar
measure.typeDistance: Now type the real distance between the two points.
measure.firstPoint: Click the first of two points a known distance apart (e.g. two cities).
measure.routeHint: Click to add points · Shift keeps 45° angles · Right-click or Enter finishes and saves · Backspace undoes · Esc cancels
measure.pathHint: Click to add points · Shift keeps 45° angles · Backspace undoes · Esc or right-click clears
measure.travelStart: Click on the map to draw the route, point by point.
measure.start: Click on the map to start measuring.
measure.uncalibrated: Calibrate the scale first to read real distances (showing map pixels).
area.polygonHint: Click to add points · click the first point, Enter or right-click to close · Backspace undoes · Esc cancels
area.polygonStart: Click on the map to start the polygon, point by point.
area.dragCircle: Drag on the map to draw a circle from its center · middle-drag pans.
area.dragRectangle: Drag on the map to draw a rectangle (Shift: a square) · middle-drag pans.
area.rectangleHint: Rectangle / Square — drag; hold Shift for an equal-sided square
area.noScale: The map has no scale yet, so areas read in map pixels. Calibrate it to get km², acres and the rest.
area.empty: Draw on the map to measure an area. Several shapes add up to a total.
legend.none: This layer has no legend yet
legend.noneHint: Each layer can have one legend, and it can also show on other layers.
legend.dragHint: Drag the legend by its title bar to move it on the map.
legend.title: Title
legend.rowsHint: The legend only takes the room its items need; past the rows, it scrolls.
legend.deleteBody_one: Delete this layer’s legend and its {n} item? This can’t be undone.
legend.deleteBody_other: Delete this layer’s legend and its {n} items? This can’t be undone.
legend.moveLabel: Move the legend (drag, or arrow keys)
legend.emptyWidget: Add items in the Legend panel.
legend.imageHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP · cropped to a small rectangle
legend.label: Label
legend.noItemsHint: Each item pairs a small image (an icon or your own picture) with a short label, e.g. a castle for “Capital”.
legend.listHint: Click an item to edit it. Drag the grip — here or on the map — to reorder.
error.saveScaleBar: Could not save the scale bar.
marker.createForMarker: Create a new article for this marker
marker.replacedHint: A replaced article stays linked in the Articles tab.
rail.selectionHint: Select: click anything on this layer to edit it
rail.markersHint: Markers: the map's markers and the icon filter
layers.title: Layers
layers.hint: Top of the list is drawn on top. Markers, zones and the grid belong to the active layer.
layers.reorderHint: Drag to reorder (or focus and use ↑/↓)
layers.activateHint: Click to make active, double-click to rename
layers.onlyOne: A map needs at least one layer
layers.replaceBody: The new image starts at the map’s top-left corner, as wide as the map. You’ll line it up right after it uploads. Markers, zones and the grid stay where they are.
layers.settingsHint: Image, position, size, opacity and what this layer always draws
layerImage.name: Name
layerImage.title: Layer settings · {name}
layerImage.processing: Processing the new image… You can line it up as soon as it’s ready.
layerImage.noImage: This layer has no image yet. Add one to place it on the map.
layerImage.preset.pixelsHint: One image pixel per map pixel
layerImage.keysHint: Arrow keys nudge too · Shift moves 10×
layerImage.alwaysImageHint: Draw this image under every layer, not only when this layer is active
layerImage.alwaysMarkersHint: Draw this layer's markers even while another layer is active (display only)
layerImage.alwaysTextsHint: Draw this layer's texts even while another layer is active (display only)
layerImage.alwaysLinesHint: Draw this layer's lines even while another layer is active (display only)
layerImage.alwaysRoutesHint: Draw this layer's routes even while another layer is active (display only)
layerImage.deleteBody: The layer stays, with its markers, zones, texts and lines. Only its image is removed.
grid.title: Grid
gridBar.label: Grid tools
gridBar.sizeHint: How many columns and rows the grid has
gridBar.linkedHint: Linked: changing one sets the other so the cells stay regular.
gridBar.alignHint: Align on the map — drag the map to slide the grid onto it (hold Shift for fine steps)
gridBar.aligning: Drag on the map to slide the grid. Hold Shift for fine steps. Middle-drag or the wheel still pan and zoom. Esc stops.
gridBar.offsetHint: Shift the grid, in % of a cell
gridBar.deleteBody: The grid of “{layer}” will be removed. Opening the Grid tool again makes a new one.
legendBar.label: Legend tools
legendBar.layersHint: Also show this legend on other layers
legendBar.imageHint: An icon, or an image you upload
markerBar.label: Marker tools
markerBar.selectHint: Select / edit — click a marker to see and change it; drag the selected one to move it
markerBar.placeHint: Add marker — click the map where it goes (it gets the look you used last)
markerBar.locked: This marker is locked: unlock it to move or delete it.
markerBar.displayHint: How big the marker is and when its name shows
markerBar.detailsHint: Category, environment, ownership, status and layers
markerCard.editHint: Edit the name, linked map, main article and description
scene.title: Scene
scene.pickHint: Show on the map and edit
checklist.alwaysDrawHint: Its layer has “Always draw” on, so it already shows on every layer.
mapForm.name: Map name
layerImage.alwaysZonesHint: Draw this layer's zones even while another layer is active (display only)
markers.noneYet: No markers on this map yet.
markers.iconHint: Toggle an icon off to hide every marker using it. This never changes marker data.
markers.groupShownHint: Icons of this group shown on the map
markerLinks.title: Links
markerArticles.relPlaceholder: Relationship (optional), e.g. Lord of this keep
markerArticles.title: Articles
markerArticles.none: No articles linked yet. Link the characters, places, lore or anything else this marker is about.
text.curveHint: Drag up to arch the text, down to bow it
viewer.assetMissing: The image record is missing. Upload the image again.
